purpose: Test natural-channel S2 receiver-utility noninferiority to eager dual execution after covering the confirm19 MPS timing tail, while retaining background-AI throughput gain.

selection_source.confirm19: Across 5,000 releases, S2 had 0 deadline misses, recovered 28 NRx-only failures, achieved 6.96% more background throughput than eager, but had five branch-bound violations and a -0.08 percentage-point aggregate correctness difference.
selection_source.confirm20: All selected NeuralRx decisions were stable across 30 repeats, input mutation was absent, and conventional decisions at mismatch traces were intrinsically variable.

radio.input: identical valid 273-PRB PUSCH construction and per-release channel seed in both policies
radio.channel: independent block-Rayleigh coefficient per RX antenna plus complex AWGN
radio.paired_trace_rule: Within each round, eager and S2 store and use the same payload seed and per-release channel seed.

timing_contract.basis: The NRx bound exceeds the 47.075 ms worst S2 aggregate GPU time observed in confirm19; the fallback interval remains fully reserved before deadline.

background.kind: separate MPS NeuralRx CUDA Graph client

statistics.utility_difference: S2 correct fraction minus eager correct fraction on paired trace indices
statistics.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% paired normal interval over per-trace values in {-1,0,1}
statistics.noninferiority_gate: lower 95% confidence limit must exceed -0.25 percentage points

interpretation_limit: This is a predeclared follow-up to confirm19. The guarantee remains conditional on admission of workloads whose measured bounds satisfy the declared timing contract.
